continuity_scope: The Banner Saga 1, English PlayStation 4 base release (Stoic LLC; 12 January 2016) as the selected product witness. The original 2014 PC release and later releases are acknowledged but not inspected as character-text witnesses.
work_or_witnesses: The Banner Saga 1 PS4 English base release (Stoic LLC; 12 January 2016)
PlayStation Blog, 'The Banner Saga Arrives on PS4 January 12th, 2016' (Stoic/Versus Evil publisher statement)
coverage_rule: Terms-only audit. No named individual is included unless a selected first-party/direct-game witness offers a claim-level character profile sufficient for a record. The selected official release, storefront, and publisher materials describe player choice, caravan persistence, permanent loss, setting inspiration, and trilogy status, but do not do so for a named character.
omissions: All named characters, clans, leaders, enemies, gods, and heroes are omitted: no claim-level first-party character-profile source was accessible in the selected witness set.
The Banner Saga 2 and 3, any save-import continuation, tabletop/live projects, DLC, and later ports/localizations are separate continuity/media witnesses.
Player-selected caravan members, permanent deaths, dialogue/travel/combat outcomes, party composition, and endings are deliberately not universalized.
uncertainties: The official PS4 product page is a 2016 port-storefront witness, not an inspected 2014 PC build or a complete game script.
First-party material says saves transfer an 'exact caravan, character, and story choices' to Banner Saga 2; this confirms branching continuity but does not establish a single canon survivor roster.
The PlayStation listing reports multiple screen languages, but this pass is bound to English terminology and makes no claim that names/text are identical across all localizations.
Because official character evidence is sparse in accessible archives, pass-complete here means complete against this zero-character coverage rule only.
evidence_basis: Stoic/Versus Evil publisher statement and PlayStation first-party product pages. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, walkthrough, or secondary roster has been used as canonical evidence.

supports: PS4 platform, Stoic publisher, 12 January 2016 release, English listing, choice-driven narrative, and permanent character-loss mechanic
